overview: A mini-ML interpreter and interactive REPL running on the Internet Computer. Type ML expressions in the browser, and the backend handles parsing, Hindley-Milner type inference, and evaluation — returning both the inferred type and computed value.
features: Backend ML engine with lexer, parser, Hindley-Milner type inference, and evaluator
Interactive REPL with evaluation history and syntax-highlighted results
Curated example gallery (factorial, higher-order functions, polymorphic types, and more)
Inferred type displayed alongside every evaluation result
Clear error messages for parse, type, and runtime failures
